verdict.rationale: Google Authenticator is a consumer one-time-passcode generator app with an open-source HOTP/TOTP implementation. It has no production API, data environment, or developer platform for which a test sandbox would be a meaningful offering, so a sandbox-versus-production testing axis is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any sandbox or test environment; features such as 'Use without an account' or offline code generation are unrelated controls and are not sandbox isolation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
